D.label: SPECTROSCOPY ROOM
D.name: Door to the spectroscopy room
D.text: The door to the instrument room. It opens once you have read the three cards.

U.label: SPECTROMETER
U.name: Spectrometer
U.text: The spectrometer: a light source, a chamber of gas, and a detector that counts the electrons that fly out. Press E to use it.

K.label: SAMPLES
K.name: Sample carousel
K.text: A carousel of sealed vapor cells, one for each element from hydrogen to calcium, and four mystery cells. Press E to use it.

B.label: DRAW BENCH
B.name: Draw bench
B.text: The draw bench: graph paper for sketching a spectrum, then checking it against the real run. Press E to use it.

W.label: TABLE
W.name: Periodic table chart
W.text: A wall chart of the first twenty elements. Position on the chart tells you the period and the group.

Y.label: PUMP
Y.name: Vacuum pump
Y.text: The pump. Electrons would hit air and stop before reaching the detector, so the chamber is pumped nearly empty.

G.label: GAS
G.name: Gas cylinders
G.text: Gas cylinders. Every sample is a vapor so that the atoms are far apart and do not bother each other.

N.label: NOTICE
N.name: Notice board
N.text: Notice: 'The spectrum shows how hard electrons are held. It does not show them moving around the atom.'
